simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מֵי הַיַּרְקוֹן (Mêy hay-Yarqôwn) means Me-haj-Jarkon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 46.

definitions.full: H4313. Me Hayyarqon יַרְקוֺן only in הַיּ ׳מֵי Josh 19:46 see below מַי . הַיַּרְקוֺן מֵי proper name, of a location in Dan, near Joppa Josh 19:46 (reading dubious; ᵐ5 ἀπὸ θαλάσσης [i.e. מים = מִיָּם ] Ιερακων ).
definitions.rootNote: from 4325 and 3420 with the art. interposed; water of the yellowness;
